makeup_policy: Make-up is not given as a routine and is considered for only regular students. It is solely dependent on the 'genuineness' of the circumstance under which a student fails to appear in a scheduled evaluation component. The students must discuss such a situation with the IC and get prior permission for make-up. In case of urgent medical emergencies, the students must ensure that the message reaches IC as soon as possible. The decision of the IC in all matters shall be final.
